title: Original task help through existing private correspondence

recipe: Check acquisition.archive.sha256 and acquisition.archive.bytes before extract.

operator.credentialLocator: The samedaydesk.com Node process env CORRESPONDENCE_ADMIN_TOKEN. It is not in this repository.
operator.continuation: GET may return complete false and nextCursor. Repeat with ?after=<nextCursor> until complete is true. A short page is not the whole queue.

notes: Public acquisition is the archive in this document. The client command is what to run after that archive is extracted. Cloning the website is not the acquisition.
Pass an explicit https service origin or loopback base URL. Describe does not call the network. Credentialed URLs, malformed origins, and redirects are refused.
Validate the task, persist one local attempt, register, and post one request event with the writer grant. An invalid task does not register.
Read the same private attempt later. A scoped result or useful refusal is written only in that directory. Pending qualification is the default.
A reply is not acceptance or reuse. Example consent is a separate correction and defaults off.
The operator lists task-bearing projects with the existing admin credential and follows nextCursor. This file does not call the network.
